consequence.statement: After upgrading to 2.7.0, `flux push artifact` works against insecure registries (the release note states this was fixed); environments that push to insecure registries regain the intended behavior with no operator action.
consequence.remediation: No action required; environments that push to insecure registries regain working behavior by upgrading.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 fixes the `flux push artifact` command so that it works with insecure registries.
